title: GINopic: Topic Modeling with Graph Isomorphism Network
task: Neural topic modelling that uses word-dependency graphs
problem: Contextual topic models treat documents as word sequences and ignore explicit word correlations; earlier graph topic models are slow or limited to sliding windows.
architecture: Each document becomes a word-similarity graph (edges between its words when embedding similarity exceeds a threshold); a Graph Isomorphism Network encodes the graph, used together with the bag-of-words representation as input to a neural topic model.
key_results: Mean NPMI/CV: 20NG 0.102/0.647 and BBC 0.130/0.701 vs CombinedTM 0.086/0.617 and 0.042/0.637.
On SO, CombinedTM has higher NPMI (0.065 vs 0.059); ECRTM has the highest IRBO on all datasets.
Classification accuracy, e.g. BBC 0.888 vs GNTM 0.806; on 20NG GINopic is slightly below GNTM (0.441 vs 0.449).
strengths: Uses the provably most expressive message-passing GNN for document graphs; sensitivity analysis of graph threshold and GNN choice.

limitations.text: Only word-similarity graphs; dependency-parse or other graph constructions not explored.
